summary:
One Light Day Away" is an interactive web animation that transforms the unimaginable scale of the universe into an intuitive, visually captivating experience. Drawing its name from the distance light travels in a single day—roughly \bm{25.9} billion kilometers (\bm{16.1} billion miles), reaching into the outer realms of our Solar System and beyond—the project invites users on an immersive journey through deep space.
Built using modern web standards and smooth canvas animations, the project bridges the gap between scientific cosmic data and digital art, making astronomical scale and light-travel concepts engaging and accessible to everyone.
details:
Vision & Purpose

Madde işareti English: The goal of "One Light Day Away" is to provide an intuitive visualization of deep-space distances. By centering the experience on a single "light-day" (\bm{~25.9 \text{ billion km}}), it bridges complex astronomical math with interactive storytelling.
